acceptanceCriteria: the qualification procedure (DOGFOOD/SELF-DEVELOPMENT or the packet README) requires retaining result digests and the per-case table in the build-log entry at run time
the S0E packet runner prints a retained-evidence summary (digests, case outcomes, toolchain, host) suitable for pasting, with a test
body: Residual from the V1-0650 lane (PR #951, 2026-10-16). The 2026-10-02 S0E packet runs (Go 1.24.13 cases 21-22, Linux arm64 54/56) wrote their result JSON under /private/tmp; on 2026-10-16 only two empty cache directories remained and no go1.24.13 toolchain was on disk, so V1-0650 AC1/AC2 rest on the ticket body and build-log prose, not retained artifacts. Expected: a qualification run copies its result JSON (or at least digests plus the case table) into the build log or a retained evidence path at run time. Actual: transient scratch only.
title: Qualification runs write result JSON only under /private/tmp; lanes lose the artifacts that AC evidence cites
